# Reproducible Grad-CAM wheel

`wheels/grad_cam-1.5.5-py3-none-any.whl` was built without code changes from the
official PyPI source distribution because pip's archive-permission restoration
failed in this Windows sandbox. Its MIT license is included in the wheel.

- Source: https://pypi.org/project/grad-cam/1.5.5/
- Source SHA-256: `690c433d226d35c89c9eb170462db204909cb06b39c7381e6880a49b6fc37015`
- Wheel SHA-256: `cd1a7205568d2edd1be982aa1707fc5cd5991a55348c2c4f5b80faadbe0e8382`

Use `--find-links vendor/wheels` with pip to prefer this platform-independent
wheel. Other dependencies and all model weights come from their upstream hosts.
